clock_audit.branch_rule: First actual CK0 fall is mastercycle0. Secondarybranch=mastercycle modulo8, bank=primarylane.
clock_audit.label_rule: Primary andsecondary shareprimarycapture symbolindex; secondaryreadtime islater.

measured_primary_aperture.method: first observed CK half-fall after warmup, modulo UI; not the requested clock delay increment

calibration.polarity_application: native P minus N at each plane, detector fits that orientation

raw_FFE.ridge_selection: fixed a priori, no search or validation tuning
raw_FFE.objective: mean squared target-amplitude error pluslambda*sum(normalized-input tap weights squared); unregularized bias

ADC_FFE.ridge_selection: fixed a priori, no search or validation tuning
ADC_FFE.objective: mean squared target-amplitude error pluslambda*sum(normalized-input tap weights squared); unregularized bias

raw_three_threshold.quality_score_definition: min(p05_next-p95_previous)/class_mean_span - 4*training_SER; minus1 if class means not strictly ordered; larger is better

ADC_three_threshold.quality_score_definition: min(p05_next-p95_previous)/class_mean_span - 4*training_SER; minus1 if class means not strictly ordered; larger is better

detectors.freeze_rule: phase/lag/ADC range selected with split training; FIRs then refit once using all training; no final validation samples
